snippet.title: And that's a wrap on @CES 2026! 🙌
snippet.description:
We’re thrilled to have kicked off CES 2026 under our theme “Innovating a Brighter Life.” 💡

This year, we shared our latest breakthroughs in display technology and smart home experiences, all designed to make life more colourful, comfortable, and connected.

🔴🟢🔵 A highlight for us was introducing RGB MiniLED evo — a real leap forward in colour, comfort, and energy efficiency — powering our new 116UXS RGB MiniLED TV. 

We also revealed the Hisense Elite Collection for the FIFA World Cup 2026™, marking our third consecutive World Cup partnership. Bringing fans together through shared experiences, on screen and throughout the home, never gets old! 

📺And we’re not stopping there! Starting January 2026, VIDAA OS will evolve into a fully integrated smart home platform, connecting content, AI, and devices to make homes smarter and simpler.
